services.advanceInterrupted: The browser interrupted the advance; the previous state is preserved.
services.databaseOpen: Could not open the checkpoint database.
services.databaseOld: Another tab is using an older database version.
services.profileProtected: A biological profile is incompatible with this version. The original was preserved and writing is protected; use a compatible version or explicitly restore a known checkpoint.
services.latestRecovered: The latest available record was recovered.
services.olderRecovered: An earlier checkpoint was recovered; the current record was unavailable.
services.legacyRecovered: An earlier save was loaded. The original will be preserved during migration.
services.recoveryFailed: Could not recover a valid record. Automatic saving is protected; import an experiment or create another terrarium.
services.writeProtected: Writing is protected until an experiment is restored or started.
services.invalidState: The state is not valid for saving.
services.newerRecord: Another tab has already saved a newer record. Reload before continuing.
services.fallbackSaved: Saved to the local backup; database checkpoints are temporarily unavailable.
services.saveFailed: Could not save. Export the experiment as JSON.
services.workerFailed: The sweep Worker failed; previous results are preserved.
services.offlineNoResponse: The browser did not respond about the offline copy.
services.offlineIncomplete: The offline copy is incomplete. Try again while connected.
services.sessionInvalid: Could not validate the state for saving.
